zh: 新任务以更平滑的动画进入看板；不在视野内时，会显示提示，方便快速定位。
优化看板性能，减少不必要的刷新，改善 Android 上运行中任务和长列表的流畅度。
修复新任务启动时短暂跳入已完成泳道的问题。
修复隐藏子任务无法从列表行打开、工作区标题未同步及侧边栏悬停背景缺失的问题。
补全活动、上下文压缩和 agent 事件的本地化，并调整标题撤销按钮和桌面端列表间距。
en: New tasks enter the board smoothly, with a prompt to locate tasks outside the current view.
Improve board performance by reducing unnecessary updates, making running tasks and long lists smoother on Android.
Fix new tasks briefly appearing in the completed lane during startup.
Fix opening hidden subtasks from their rows, workspace title synchronization, and missing sidebar hover backgrounds.
Localize activity, compaction, and agent event labels, and refine the title undo button and desktop list spacing.
